title: task archive takes no --if-revision, so a guarded edit followed by an archive cannot close its race window
description:
Requested by opum-agent (cross-session, 2026-09-29), from an independent review of opum-ai/opum-agent#1446 (OPAG-799, F1). The request: the operator-request helper retires a record with a guarded `task edit --if-revision` followed by `task archive`; the archive cannot be guarded, so a record that changes between the two steps is still archived. A re-read narrows the window in the helper, but only a guarded archive closes it.

MEASURED on quest-cli dev at d58a8286 and on the installed 0.11.0: `quest help task archive` lists only actor flags -- the "task archive" entry in src/application/command-help.ts carries flags: [...ACTOR_FLAGS] -- and Tasks.archive() in src/application/tasks/tasks.ts takes no revision precondition, routing straight to moveTask(reference, "archive/tasks", operationId). The existing guard is `task edit --if-revision` (QCLI-277), which refuses a stale edit as a conflict; QCLI-374 fixed that refusal to report conflict rather than validation. QCLI-389 tracks a surviving exit-6 edge on the edit path when a stale edit also carries a gone removal target.

DESIRED: `quest task archive <id> --if-revision <revision>` with the semantics edit already has: the precondition is the per-record revision a caller captures from `quest task view --json`; a stale value refuses the archive as a conflict (exit 5) and moves nothing; a current value archives exactly as today.

SCOPE: archive is the measured gap. Whether the other lifecycle moves (complete, pause, start, demote) want the same guard is NOT decided here and is out of this task. No design is decided by the requester.

acceptanceCriteria.text: `quest task archive <id> --if-revision <rev>` is accepted; with the revision captured from `quest task view --json` just before, the archive proceeds as today and relocates the record to `archive/tasks`.
With a stale revision the archive is refused as a conflict -- exit 5 -- and the record is not moved; the refusal is distinguishable from a usage error (exit 2) and a validation error (exit 6).
The revision compared is the same per-record value `quest task view --json` emits and `task edit --if-revision` compares against, so one captured value works for either command.
`quest help task archive` and the machine command registry document the flag.

plan: 1. Give Tasks.archive an optional { ifRevision } and enforce it in moveTask right after the record resolves, returning the same TaskWriteConflict guard shape (code revision_precondition_failed) QCLI-425 established -- only archive passes it; complete/pause/start/demote stay unguarded per the task scope.
2. Accept --if-revision on task archive in src/cli/main.ts (allowed flags + dispatch) and document it in the task archive help entry (flags, usage, summary), which feeds the machine registry.

3. New test/qcli423-archive-if-revision.test.ts: control archives with the current revision and relocates to archive/tasks; stale refuses exit 5, name nothing moved, carries sentRevision/actualRevision; one captured value works for edit and archive; the refusal differs from a usage error (2) and a validation error (6); help and manifest name the flag.
4. bun run check under pinned 1.4.2; branch, PR, required checks, merge.
implementationNotes: FAMILY OBSERVATION, requested by opum-agent 2026-09-29: the same absence recorded here for archive holds across the whole lifecycle family, measured on dev at 47dc4095 -- `task complete` carries only --final-summary, `task pause` and `task start` only the actor flags, and `task demote` only --to; none accept --if-revision. QCLI-423 stays archive-scoped by the requester call: archive is the only lifecycle step the retirer runs after a guarded edit. Whether to generalise the guard to the other moves is a CLI design question for the operator if the need ever arises; nothing filed for it, and no design is decided here.

IMPLEMENTED 2026-09-30 (session 8e31abf1). task archive now takes --if-revision with edit's semantics. Tasks.archive accepts an optional { ifRevision } and moveTask enforces it immediately after the record resolves and before any state change -- comparing the same per-record revision task view --json emits and edit compares against -- returning the same TaskWriteConflict guard shape QCLI-425 established (code revision_precondition_failed, expectedRevision = the sent value), so the CLI's existing classifier gives it the mismatch message with input {sentRevision, actualRevision}. Only archive passes the option: complete, pause, start and demote stay unguarded, per the scope this record set. The flag is accepted on task archive in main.ts and documented in the help entry (flags, usage, summary), which feeds the machine registry.

VERIFIED. test/qcli423-archive-if-revision.test.ts, five CLI-level tests against real workspaces: the current revision archives and relocates the record to archive/tasks and only there; a sentinel refuses with exit 5, names the mismatch, echoes sentRevision beside actualRevision, and moves nothing (still under tasks/, absent from the archive); one captured value works across edit and archive in both directions -- a revision an edit invalidated is stale for archive too, and the conflict names the same per-record series; the guard's exit 5 is distinct from a usage error (unknown flag, exit 2) and a validation error (already at destination, exit 6); and both quest help task archive and the manifest registry name the flag. Mutation, localized: reverting ONLY the service guard while keeping the CLI flag and help reddens exactly tests 2, 3 and 4, with the control and help/manifest tests green; restored, 5 of 5. Full bun run check under pinned bun 1.4.2: 1072 pass, 0 fail, typecheck/lint/format/layers clean.

NOT DONE, deliberately: the other lifecycle moves (complete, pause, start, demote) have no guard; whether they want one is out of this record's scope and undecided.
finalSummary: task archive now accepts --if-revision with task edit's semantics: the optional precondition is enforced in moveTask immediately after the record resolves and before any write, compares the same per-record revision task view --json emits, refuses a stale value as exit 5 carrying input.sentRevision beside actualRevision with the QCLI-425 mismatch message, and moves nothing; a current value archives exactly as before, relocating to archive/tasks. Only archive is guarded -- complete/pause/start/demote stay as they were, undecided. Help and the machine registry document the flag. Verified by five CLI-level tests (control and relocation; stale refusal moving nothing; cross-command revision equivalence in both directions; exit-5 vs usage-2 vs validation-6; help + manifest), a localized mutation reddening exactly the three guard-dependent tests, and the full check (1072 pass, 0 fail).
